source_title: UNESCO World Trends freedom of expression and media development
direct_observation: Freedom of Expression Index declined roughly 10%; governance, journalist hostility, economic stress and AI disinformation are highlighted
evidence_status: high for global signal; index does not prove local access or outcome
next_test: link one country/region trend to named outlet, audience and institutional response

source_title: UNESCO Journalism Shaping a World at Peace
direct_observation: platforms take substantial advertising revenue while professional outlets struggle with viability and plural coverage
evidence_status: high for economic mechanism; outlet-level continuity and independence remain open
next_test: track ownership, revenue, editorial control, distribution and local coverage

source_title: UNESCO 2026 journalist safety and impunity findings
direct_observation: 189 journalists killed in violent attacks; 67% in conflict zones; overall impunity reached 86%
evidence_status: high for documented safety signal; attribution, denominator and later justice remain bounded
next_test: follow named killing through investigation, prosecution, remedy and deterrence

direct_observation: 75% of surveyed women journalists/media workers faced online violence; gendered threats can affect participation
evidence_status: medium-to-high survey mechanism; sample and protective-effect limits remain
next_test: track named harassment, platform/police/newsroom response, self-censorship and retention

direct_observation: more than 900 journalists were forced into exile; displacement can weaken local media ecosystems and create news deserts
evidence_status: medium case and regional signal; causal local-information effect remains open
next_test: compare local, exiled and platform-only reporting for access, trust and accountability

unit_or_scope: global verified cases since 1993 and judicial status since 2006
direct_observation: multiple sources verify professional connection and public records track judicial status, while unresolved and reporting limits remain
evidence_status: high for source boundary; observatory is not a complete safety or civic-outcome panel
next_test: combine case records with audience access, source safety and later institutional action
